role: archive audit; values labelled archive are provenance checks, not independent trajectory reproduction

geometry.type: transverse harmonic expansion for infinite cylinders inside grounded circular shield, plus independent ideal three-dimensional DC quadrupole
geometry.source: verification_coeffs.npz (N=24; p=48). mfs_coefficients.csv contains coarser p=32 and also N=36. geometry_spectra.csv belongs to earlier 12-electrode screening.
geometry.aperture_archive: accept r<=1 and abs(z)<=2; radial cutoff is the inscribed free cylinder. Axial cutoff is a numerical exit criterion.

normalization.force: a_i=(m1/m_i)*[-grad(P_RF)+beta*(x,y,-2z)+C*(u_i-u_j)/|u_i-u_j|^3]-lambda_i*v_i. P_RF sums the real parts of both carriers. grad(DC) supplies zero direct z torque.
normalization.voltage_phase: V_j=Re[exp(ik0 theta_j-i Omega t)], k0=(+2,-4), leading phases negligible. Positive growing azimuth is counterclockwise when viewed from +z.

archive_rotation_accounting.energy_identity: Delta(K+U_DC+U_C)=W_RF+W_drag. Archive work columns 14,16 (zero-based) store positive heat, requiring negative sign for drag work.
archive_rotation_accounting.source: archived base128.npz; q1=q2. Positive time-averaged RF power in each particle replenishes sustained losses.

oseen.closure: F_drag=-lambda_i v_i(1+b|v_i|), b=0.5, corresponds to Re_D=(16/3)*b*|v_i| if identified with the leading diameter-based Oseen correction.
oseen.physical_scope: Illustrative perturbation of drag. Equal lambda and equal b for unequal masses cannot both follow from no-slip Stokes-Oseen drag on two spheres in one fluid: lambda_i proportional to a_i/m_i, b_i proportional to a_i. Archive specifies no physical radii or fluid to establish Re/Kn.

archive_checks_limited.independent_py: Late DOP853 segment 14000-14200 periods restarts from archived RK4 state and imports the same archived RHS. Independent RHS must be implemented separately in this verification.
archive_checks_limited.retained: In the source the radial/axial aperture is tested after every whole RK step, while the published archive trajectory stores one state per primary RF period; archived mean radii refer to those stroboscopic samples.
